intent: Perform read-only security analysis on authentication, authorization, secrets, sensitive data, trust boundaries and high-risk integrations when policy requires security review.
steps: Analyze only the security dimensions relevant to the change scope
Separate observation from assessment and unknowns
Review ownership and tenant isolation where applicable
Review input validation and injection surfaces
Review sensitive data exposure and logging
Review trust boundaries and external integrations
Review negative permission cases and dangerous configuration defaults
Return findings with evidence, severity, exploit preconditions, affected scope and recommended remediation
invariants: Read-only: do not modify evaluated code
Distinguish confirmed issues from unverified risks
